title: the vehicles, with the *mechanism* attached
dek: Five storytelling structures and three affordable layouts, clustered from the measured pool, each with a mechanism card - the retention psychology, the failure mode, and the transfer conditions that stats alone cannot give. Two proven pairs and one labeled bet make the test set.

sections.heading: copying winners without the mechanism is cargo cult
sections.body: A format is two things layered: the storytelling structure (how the spoken words are organized) and the visual layout (how it is shot). Every in-pool multiple bundles channel effect, topic effect, and guest effect - Sabri's 14.1x rides a 504K channel, foundr's 15.9x rides a half-billion-dollar guest, and the 64.2x ceiling is one channel's nineteen-year franchise. So every structure carries a mechanism card: the named psychological reason it holds attention, how it dies in unskilled hands, and what must be true for it to survive the jump to this operator's topics and his 1-3 hour naptime constraint. Format hunting is finite: test three, crown one or two heroes by batch three, then reps.

rows.claim: S1 The Compression Promise - promise-debt plus ranked-completion pull. 5 rows, median 10.8x
rows.evidence: 'Give Me 27 Minutes and I'll Make You Disgustingly Good at Digital Marketing' - 201K, 14.1x, 2026-07-31. Failure mode: promise bigger than payload reads as betrayal

rows.claim: S2 The Shift Analysis - chaos vigilance plus insider decoding. 6 rows, ceiling 64.2x (person-effect flagged)
rows.evidence: 'Amazon Just Lost Control Of Shopping!' - 1.4M, 64.2x, 2026-04-28; transcript shows the beat order: event number, why the giant is scared, what it means for you, the move

rows.claim: S3 The Witness - possibility witness; the scar makes the outcome credible. 7 rows, median 5.7x
rows.evidence: Quad Lock exit interview - 39K, 15.9x, 2026-07-30: 'no investors, no playbook, just an idea.' Confound: celebrity-guest effect; the mechanism transfers, the guest list does not

rows.claim: S4 The Template Reveal - artifact desire; viewers watch to earn the thing. 4 rows, max 19.9x
rows.evidence: Product-page blueprint held on screen throughout - 12K, 19.9x, 2025-01-10. His claim-safety sheet and angle-map anatomy are real internal artifacts, so the format demos the actual service

rows.claim: S5 The Roundtable - eavesdropping on peers; disagreement is the retention
rows.evidence: 'Do This to Scale Your CPG Brand' - 9.9K, 14.2x, 2026-08-13. Transfer note: for him, guesting beats hosting - zero production cost, borrowed Ring-2 distribution

sections.heading: the test set: two proven pairs, one *bet*
sections.dek: Recipes at the operator's real constraint level: phone, natural light, naptime blocks, spoken-first.

items.action: Pick 1 - The Claim Ladder (Compression x Talking head + receipts)
items.why: Proven pair (14.1x specimen); his payloads are enumerable; 60-90 min per rep: voice memo first, one session, a 45-90s cut and a 3-5min cut

items.action: Pick 2 - The Regulatory News-Jack (Shift Analysis x Talking head)
items.why: Proven skeleton, unclaimed beat: FTC/FDA warning letters and platform health-policy, 24-48h turnaround, Monday 20-minute sweep

items.action: Pick 3 - The Counter Consult (self-witness x paper prop) - THE labeled bet
items.why: Nobody in-pool runs self-witness monologue; one bet allowed and this is it, fallback written: pitch the stories to the roundtables as a guest instead

items.action: After 2-3 batches: crown 1-2 heroes, stop testing, start reps
items.why: The hero-format rule; the calibration tracker's working= numbers make the call

sections.heading: the honest *ceiling*
sections.body: Recording and delivery cannot be automated by any of this. The recipes are model-and-mimic: angles, distance, pacing, where the text hook sits. The last mile is him on camera, and the spoken-first pipeline exists because that is where his quality lives. Scope limits: the matrix measures YouTube only (TikTok/Instagram coverage: none); his LinkedIn carousel and DM formats sit outside this artifact's evidence.
